name: Mayinglong Pharmaceutical Group Co., Ltd.
summary: Mayinglong Pharmaceutical Group Co., Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, manufactures and sells Chinese and Western medicines in China and internationally. It operates through three segments: Pharmaceutical Manufacturing; Pharmaceutical Wholesale and Retail; and Medical Services. The company offers functional cosmetics, care products and food, Chinese herbal medicines, and medical devices.
